As dirretry r2 (d2f1243): REMOTE60_TEST_TMP must name one plain folder directly under the anchor
D:/remote/remote/.claude/test-tmp (the anchor and the folder no links); without it the test refuses to run before
creating or deleting anything (exit 2). The agent's cache file has a per-process name in that root, and the test's
one delete goes through a guard (a file directly in the root, no "..", nothing else).

r2 named a fixed file beside the executable (C:/work/gnlink-wt/ka-r3/build/apps/native_poc/Release/
host_agent_punch_test.cache) and deleted it at start and end. The agent never wrote it (SaveCache follows a successful
registration / an accepted migration heartbeat only; the directory there is 127.0.0.1:9, nobody answers): in its
7 executions (3 base, 3 mutants, 1 restore) every delete found no file. The path does not exist now.

Product unchanged (6c3cb5a SOURCE OK). 9/9 x3 in D:/remote/remote/.claude/test-tmp/ka-punch (empty afterwards);
unset -> refused (exit 2); a root outside the anchor -> refused (exit 2).
